1 Day = 60 Ghati
1 Ghati = 60 Pal
1 Pal = 60 Vipal

Unlike the modern 24-hour clock, 1 modern second equals 2.5 Vipals. Because the clock updates every real second, the Vipal visibly jumps by 2 or 3 to keep perfectly synced with astronomical time!
